annotations.title: Extract Shopify Store Products, Variants & Pricing

description: Extract complete e-commerce product catalogs, SKU variant pricing, compare-at discount percentages, inventory stock status, vendor tags, and image URLs from any Shopify-powered store.

collectionHandle.description: Optional Shopify collection slug filter (leave empty for all store products).

maxProductsPerStore.description: Maximum number of products to extract per Shopify domain.

stores.description: Shopify store domains or URLs to scrape (e.g., ["allbirds.com", "gymshark.com"]).

name: extract_shopify_store_catalog
